title: DOH ORDERS ABC TOWING TO IMMEDIATELY HALT OPERATIONS AND CLEAN UP HAZARDOUS MATERIALS AT FACILITY
summary: HONOLULU — The Hawaiʻi Department of Health (DOH) issued an Administrative Order against ABC Towing & Parts, LLC and property owner JH Hawaii Property, LLC under state Environmental Response Law (HRS 128D), due to hazardous substances following a September 30 fire at the ABC Towing facility. ABC Towing has been ordered to immediately cease operations […]
author: adamlefebvre
title_norm: doh orders abc towing to immediately halt operations and clean up hazardous materials at facility
